scenes.title: 2011 University of Notre Dame Real-Room Lab: Carrying Concealed Shoeboxes Through an Open Doorway vs Same-Room Walk
scenes.era: 2011, Department of Psychology real-room testing suite, University of Notre Dame, Indiana

layout.description: Sunlit two-room Notre Dame testing suite bisected by a crisp oak doorframe: Table A in Room 1 holds geometric colored wooden blocks, while Table B sits just beyond the open doorway beside Gabriel Radvansky's probe clipboard.

positions.who: 48-year-old volunteer (in smart-casual collared shirt and navy sweater)
positions.where: stepping directly through the oak doorway carrying a closed white cardboard shoebox with both hands toward Table B
positions.facing: walking forward across the doorway threshold toward the researcher

positions.who: Gabriel Radvansky (researcher in tweed blazer holding a recognition probe card)
positions.where: standing beside Table B in Room 2 flipping up a two-word object probe card the instant the volunteer crosses the doorway
positions.facing: angled toward the arriving volunteer at Table B

props.name: closed white cardboard carry shoebox and crimson wooden wedge block
props.period_detail: 2011 Notre Dame Experiment 2 concealed-carry box hiding colored wooden shapes from sight while walking
props.physical_behavior: State-A volunteer drops crimson wooden wedge into box and presses lid shut at Table A -> State-B steps through oak doorway to Table B and freezes with hand hovering over the closed lid

props.name: solid oak architectural doorframe and flip-up object probe stand
props.period_detail: real-room physical doorway contrasting against equal-distance open-room tape line
props.physical_behavior: State-A open doorway marks room transition -> State-B researcher flips up probe card as volunteer stalls at 28% error rate vs 23% same-room walk

actions.verb_sequence: tucks the crimson wooden block inside the shoebox, closes the lid, and walks briskly through the oak doorway -> stops abruptly at Table B with palms raised in sudden confusion
flips up the object probe card on Table B and marks the doorway error spike on his clipboard

reactions.reaction: blinks in amused disbelief at forgetting an object placed in the box five seconds earlier
points back to the oak doorframe identifying the Event Horizon boundary

scenes.wardrobe: 2011 American campus smart-casual: navy crewneck sweater over Oxford shirt; brown tweed jacket and slacks.
scenes.lighting: Clean high-key Midwestern tall-window daylight across warm oak flooring.
scenes.recognition_hook: Walk ten feet across one room and you remember; walk the exact same ten feet through a doorframe and your working memory resets.

key_visual.description: an adult volunteer stepping through an oak doorway carrying a closed white shoebox toward a researcher holding up an object-probe card at a wooden table

scenes.title: Outdoor Sunlit Front Porch to Hallway Threshold: Stepping Inside From Gardening & Blanking Under Multitasking Load
scenes.era: Modern Saturday morning sunlit suburban front porch and garden walk

layout.description: Sunlit outdoor brick front porch bordered by potted hydrangeas opening through a wide front door into a bright entryway.

positions.where: kneeling on the sunlit outdoor porch beside garden shears, standing up while glancing at a buzzing wristwatch, and stepping across the open front-door threshold
positions.facing: walking from bright outdoor porch across the threshold

props.name: potted porch hydrangea, garden twine spool, and open front doorway
props.period_detail: everyday American weekend porch gardening setup
props.physical_behavior: State-A homeowner sets down empty twine spool on outdoor porch steps -> State-B crosses open front doorway while glancing at watch and stops dead inside the foyer with empty hands

actions.verb_sequence: sets the empty twine spool on the porch railing, glances at a wristwatch alert, and strides across the front-door threshold -> halts mid-step staring at empty palms

reactions.reaction: tilts head with a relatable half-laugh realizing the doorway wiped the garden errand

scenes.wardrobe: Weekend chambray work shirt with rolled sleeves and canvas trousers.
scenes.lighting: Crisp golden morning outdoor sunlight contrasting with airy indoor foyer.
scenes.recognition_hook: Juggle two thoughts while stepping off your front porch through the door, and the threshold files your errand away.

scenes.title: Carrying the Physical Cue Across the Kitchen Doorway: Unwrapped Parcel Beats the Reset

layout.description: Airy home doorway connecting a living-room side table to a sunlit kitchen island drawer.

positions.where: carrying the brown parcel directly through the kitchen doorway and pulling open the utility drawer for scissors without a second's pause
positions.facing: striding cleanly into the kitchen toward the island drawer

props.name: unopened brown kraft parcel and stainless kitchen scissors
props.period_detail: tangible household cue carried across the room boundary
props.physical_behavior: State-A hands pick up brown parcel before leaving living room -> State-B carry parcel through kitchen doorway and slide drawer open straight to the scissors

actions.verb_sequence: lifts the parcel in one hand, crosses the kitchen doorway, and pulls open the utility drawer to lift out the scissors smoothly

reactions.reaction: nods with effortless clarity as the physical hand cue bridges the room reset

scenes.recognition_hook: Carry one physical cue in your hand or say one noun out loud, and your errand rides safely across any doorway.

spatial_contrast_spec.landmark_or_object_a: Single continuous 10-foot living-room walk keeping memory intact
spatial_contrast_spec.landmark_or_object_b: 10-foot walk crossing an open kitchen doorway threshold where the memory track snaps

spatial_contrast_spec.cut_b_topdown_3d_arrow: 90-degree top-down two-room floorplan where a solid #FF2525 3D extruded arrow fractures cleanly at the doorway frame
